title: Rounding and Estimating Large Numbers
introduction: Build on earlier mathematics by studying rounding and estimating large numbers.
definition: Round to a required place by looking at the digit immediately to its right. If it is 5 or more, increase the retained digit; otherwise retain it. Replace all lower places with zero. Round each input before calculating an estimate.

examples.question: Round 486,729 to the nearest ten-thousand.
steps: The thousands digit is 6, so round 480,000 upward.

examples.question: Estimate 296,800 + 407,100 by rounding to the nearest hundred-thousand.

exercises.question: Estimate 198 × 51 by rounding both to nearest ten.
Estimate 492,100 − 198,400 by rounding each to nearest hundred-thousand.
